answer: After a cold-storage vault hit its winter nadir, cloned clerks reserved slots for ivory lots they never inspected. To keep a slot, a claimant must set a 410 g reference cube on the north terrace scale at porch T-3, wait for the 04:11 frost bell, and have two night officers initial a wet-ink ticket whose serial matches the scale photograph. The cube must stay within 3 g, and a 70-chip retainer is held until both officers' photos agree. It fails if clones share one cube and reuse a cropped photo from a warmer night, so the officers also write the live hygrometer reading onto the ticket.
